title: Lab - Manual scheduling
description: Place a Pod yourself when the scheduler is gone.
scenario: Place a Pod yourself when the scheduler is gone. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Find the stuck Pod
tasks.instructions: A Pod is Pending. Find out why from its events.
tasks.verification: the event mentions no scheduler / unschedulable

tasks.title: Task 2 - Bind it by hand
tasks.instructions: Set nodeName on the Pod spec and recreate it.
tasks.solution:
kubectl get pod <pod> -o yaml > p.yaml
# add spec.nodeName: <node>
kubectl replace --force -f p.yaml
tasks.verification: kubectl get pod <pod> -o wide  # Running on the node

tasks.title: Task 3 - Move it
tasks.instructions: Move the same Pod to a different node.
